memory.cares: Staying healthy, learning through small real trials, and sharing useful findings without exhausting local supplies.

heard.text: My whole-root trial ran 8 rounds: exposed and carried roots each gained 9.205 decay, difference zero. No preservation benefit shown; water and contamination unmeasured. I have no hazelnut findings. Roots I ate gave nutrition 14, toxicity 0.

My 9-round root trial showed equal decay in the exposed and carried samples: both gained 10.4105, with no rain. This did not establish drying, preservation or safety; ground contamination was not assessed.

My 10-round whole-berry trial showed equal decay gains: 12.0331 exposed and carried, with no rain. Water was not measured; drying, preservation and safety remain unverified. Ground contamination was not assessed.

value.summary: I have two hazelnuts and have learned a mechanical opening method, but have not opened or eaten them. Nutrition and toxicity remain unknown. I will inspect one and collect stone pressure-tool candidates; opening would not establish food safety.

baseline.function: Transfer a nearby ground stack into personal inventory.
Place owned units on the ground.
Hand owned units to an adjacent actor.
Send a short message to a currently visible actor.
Read a current-world capability contract or retained personal record.
Offer a personally tested finding or independently accept an actual nearby offer.
Give a name of up to 60 characters to this place (empty subject) or to a visible object or nearby item; naming the same subject again replaces your name for it.
Leave a mark or inscription of up to 120 characters on the ground here (empty subject) or on an object or item within reach.
Say up to 240 characters aloud; everyone living within 5 units hears it, seen or not.
Invite listeners to meet at a place and a later round within 200 rounds, with an optional note of up to 120 characters.
baseline.args: x: number, y: number, round: integer>=1, text

candidates.function: Lay whole units of your own food on open ground or an existing food surface to expose them to actual weather, optionally keeping a carried control from the same stack; inspect both
Press one whole unit of your own firm food, such as a nut, once between two rigid pressure surfaces to crack or split its outer layer, or inspect a food unit for its visible outer

execution.progress: Each mode is one atomic round. The trial record (batch, control, placement, readings, rain rounds, last update) persists; exposure continues unattended without charge until stop, removal, spoilage or death.

details.costs: Study: 2 rounds. Start: inputStackId is the exact id of your own unspoiled, untreated berry or root stack (or food whose water composition is already represented); quantity whole units to expose; optional controlQuantity whole units of the same stack kept carried and reserved (together at most its whole units). Place at x,y (default your position) within 0.65 plus your body radius, or on supportId, an existing food surface in reach. One round and 1 + 0.5 x quantity energy; all checks run before any charge; walking there is a separate navigate. Inspect: your open trial, within reach of the batch; one round, 0.2 energy. Stop: one round, no energy. Taking the food back uses pickup at its own cost. No tool, fuel, cutting or material is used or made.
details.effects: Start separates the units and lays them, unowned, on a ground footprint of 0.04 per unit (firm ordinary ground inside the world, not water, wet bank or waterlogged ground, unobstructed, nothing else lying there) or on the support, and gives them the world food water record (assumed water fraction root 0.75, berry 0.85). Every later round the existing rules apply: whole food loses no water; rain on the uncovered surface adds 0.01 x rain x area water; decay continues at the ordinary rate for the temperature where the food lies and is never reset. The control ages normally while carried. So no dryness, preservation or safety status can be reached: they stay unverified; nutrition and toxicity are unchanged; contamination is not assessed. Anyone may pick up food lying in the world: taking part reduces the batch, taking all ends the trial. Inspect records elapsed rounds, quantities, decay at placement and now and per round for batch and control, their difference and rain on the batch, as an unverified personal record; water content is not measured. Spoilage under the existing rule or removal ends the trial; stop ends it and leaves the batch where it lies. Ending releases the control once; death ends it the same way. No refund, reward or comfort.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Search results are indexes. Exact queries return one record per offset. All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience. Exact-id queries return a complete record of up to 6000 code units as one value in a single result; larger records keep the paged form. Paged records omit their per-record notes: concatenate all parts before parsing; continue with the same exact id. An entry marked inRetrieval is shown with at least the same content under the same id in this input's retrieval. Work records marked settled are completed, stopped or cancelled and show only identity, ability, mode, status, target, products and last payment; an exact state query with the same key returns the complete record. observation.terrain rows are "y:x:cells" strings: each character of cells is the terrain kind of one visible cell, at x, x+1, ... in row y. abilities.baseline entries with id, function and args summarize interfaces you neither used in the last 25 rounds nor need now. args lists the arguments in order: a bare name is a string; otherwise its type with any bounds (number>=lo, integer<=hi, integer lo..hi, and a bare lo..hi is a number range) or its choices a|b; ? marks an optional argument and "" means none. An exact abilities query by id returns the complete contract, including references and string limits of 200 or more code units.

value.question: How can I maintain a dependable food reserve while learning about alternative foods and food aging?
evidence: At tick 21, inventory contains 7 berries and 0.9 hazelnut.
Personal berry knowledge records nutrition 8 and toxicity 0.
The tick 21 physical press trial consumed 0.1 hazelnut and measured held=true and flexibility=0 at load 0.2.
The public air-exposure trial contract provides matched decay readings, but does not establish drying, preservation, or safety.
value.uncertainty: Hazelnut nutrition and toxicity remain unknown. The decay difference between an exposed berry and a carried control has not been personally measured.
value.goal: Maintain a known-safe food reserve and develop reusable skills for small, controlled food investigations.
completedSteps: Gathered berries and ate berry meals.
Observed a hazelnut plant and gathered a sample.
Asked nearby people for tested hazelnut findings.
Completed a small mechanical hazelnut trial.
outputs: Personal berry nutrition and toxicity record.
value.missing: Evidence about hazelnut nutrition and toxicity; personal matched food-aging observations.
value.next: Learn the air-exposure interface, compare one exposed berry with one carried control, stop the trial, then retrieve the exposed food if it survives.
value.benefit: Seven known-safe berries remain owned at tick 21; the mechanical trial adds physical evidence but no established food-safety benefit.

value.name: Cutting edge selection and inspection
value.function: Look over a reachable loose material source for cutting-edge pieces, or inspect one of your own carried pieces, and report each requirement of the stone-edge rule (stone or flint, hardness index 8+, edge radius at most 0.0002, not fractured or contaminated) with its evidence and pass or fail. Shaping is not available.
value.costs: Study: 3 rounds, 0.5 energy each. select: sourceId, a loose non-food material source within reach; one round, 0.2 energy; nothing is gathered (gather costs 2 energy per unit). inspect: inputStackId, your own carried unreserved non-food item of at least one whole unit; one round, 0.2 energy. Both need light: outdoors daylight above 0.1, indoors light above 0.1. shape and any instrumentIds are refused. All checks run before any charge; travel, gathering and pickup are separate.
value.effects: Reports, as an unverified personal record, the material, whole units and the world contact model hardness index, edge radius (0.001 / index when unworn), wear, fracture, contamination and controlled contact, each marked observed, model value or failed against the rule thin-slice-food-drying-trial@1 applies, and whether all are met. Under this model every intact, unworn whole stone (index 8, radius 0.000125) or flint unit (9, 0.000111) meets it; each scratch stroke that wears a piece adds 0.00001 to its radius. Loose source units are not individually represented, so select reports what one gathered unit would show. Nothing is gathered, shaped, measured by an instrument or changed; no tool, equipment or food safety is created. Shaping is refused: the world has no fracture, flaking or sharpening law and abrasion only blunts. The drying trial still runs its own check and must be learned separately. No refund or reward.

execution.progress: Each mode is one atomic round; a look commits only when its round completes. No work, escrow or process persists.

value.name: Thin-slice food drying trial
value.function: Cut one whole unit of your own root or berry into thin slices with a carried stone or flint edge, lay them in one thin layer on open ground or a food surface to air-dry under actual weather, optionally keeping a carried same-stack control; inspect; re-lay slices you picked up; stop.
value.costs: Study: 4 rounds, 0.5 energy each. prepare: inputStackId, your own unspoiled uncut root or berry stack with 1 + controlQuantity whole units (one unit per trial); toolId, your own carried whole stone or flint unit whose edge passes the world contact model (radius at most 0.0002, hardness 8+, not fractured or contaminated); a layer area of 5 x unit mass: a ground footprint centred at x,y (default your position) within 0.65 plus your radius, or supportId, a food surface in reach at least that large. One round, 1.5 energy. inspect: in reach of the slices or carrying them; one round, 0.2 energy. resume: re-lays slices you picked up, same placement rules, no cutting; one round, 0.2 energy. stop: one round, no energy. All checks run before any charge; travel, gathering and pickup are separate. instrumentId is refused: no calibrated balance exists.
value.effects: Cutting keeps the unit's mass, water, nutrition, toxicity, decay and age; no offcut is represented; the edge gains no wear. Slices lie unowned as one sample with the world food water record (assumed water fraction root 0.75, berry 0.85; opening damage 1.1). Each round: water moves toward an equilibrium fraction 0.1 + 0.25 x air humidity (0.1-0.35) by at most 0.025 x area x (temperature - 5)/20 (0-2), so no gradient or warmth, no drying; rain on the uncovered layer adds 0.01 x rain x area; decay is the ordinary rate x 1.1 x (0.15 + 0.85 x water fraction/initial) (0.15-1.5), never reset. The control ages normally while carried. Inspect records elapsed rounds, quantities, model decay of slices and control and their difference, visible shrinkage and wetness, and rain rounds as an unverified record; shrinkage does not measure water; spoilage, contamination, preservation and safety stay unverified. Anyone may take lying food: you taking the slices pauses the trial until resume; others taking them, spoilage, stop or death end it and release the control once. No refund or reward.

execution.progress: Each mode is one atomic round; a cut commits only when its round completes. The trial record persists; exposure continues unattended without charge until stop, removal, spoilage or death.

Give factual evidence and observed benefits, never claimed physical changes. Partial plans and protected-state edits are rejected.
